subject.text: Starting Monday, email login requires MFA

body.text: Starting Monday, logging in to office email needs your password and an OTP code from your phone.
The setup guide is on the office portal. Open it from your bookmark, not from an email.
Remember, the IT Team will never ask for your OTP code.

explanation: This email comes from the real office domain, has no links, and even reminds you not to share your OTP. It is a legitimate announcement.
hints: Is this email asking you for anything?
The domain is real and the message is actually security advice.
